newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 350-800 lb feeder steers and heifers. Trade moderate. Demand moderate. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 42 percent, over 600 lbs 53 percent with cows and bulls around 5 percent of total supply.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - few 600-700 lbs 79.00-83.00; 700-750 lbs 76.25-81.00; small lot 883 lbs 73.75.
Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 83.00- 84.25; 700-800 lbs 74.75-75.00; lot 867 lbs and lot 911 lbs 71.50. Small and Medium 1-2-two lots 525-575 lbs 83.00-83.75; pkg 704 lbs 76.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 74.25-77.50; 700-800 lbs 75.00-76.00. Medium and Large 1-2 - small lot 500-600 lbs 72.00-75.75; 675-800 lbs 66.50-73.75.
